[P2] Recheck histories already terminal in the frozen capture

The settlement-time filter skips all history comparisons when retirement acknowledges settlement after the observation window, even if the frozen history was already terminal. Using the existing normal-return fixture, whose window ends at 200 and settlement is recorded at 210, changing only the retirement snapshot's successful execution result to an unexpected value still passes adjudication. The final audit uses the frozen history, so it cannot catch this contradiction. Include executions with frozen terminal histories in reconciliation regardless of retirement acknowledgment time, while preserving the allowance for executions that remained running through the observation window.
